The '''''Unrepentant''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was operated by a crew of six [[Spice/Legends|spice]] raiders<ref name="TF" /> during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Scourge">The novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']] established that events of ''[[Tempest Feud]]'' took place in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Unrepentant'' featured in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure ''[[Tempest Feud]]'', by [[Jeff Grubb]] and [[Owen K.C. Stephens]]. In the adventure, the player characters travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] to shutdown production of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]] on the world. If the players alert the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]]&mdash;who was secretly the mastermind behind the development of Tempest&mdash;about their mission, Mika hires the ''Unrepentant'' via a blind contract to patrol near the planet [[Rhilithan]] and attempt to thwart the players efforts to capture the Varl-bound [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Barabi Run]]''. The adventure also advised that the ''Unrepentant'' use similar [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] statistics to ''Barabi Run'', which was a [[MB-C1 medium transport|Mobquet medium transport]], but did not confirm whether the ''Unrepentant'' was itself a [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. In [[2012]], the novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], an adaptation of ''Tempest Feud'' was published, and it established the [[canon]] series of role-playing outcomes for the ''Tempest Feud''. The book makes no mention of the ''Unrepentant'' and establishes that Mika was not warned of the mission to strike against Varl, so this article therefore assumes that the hire of the ''Unrepentant'' by Mika is non-canon.
